Class GroceryManagement

java.lang.Object
GroceryManagement
public class GroceryManagement extends Object
GroceryManagement is a simple console-based grocery inventory system.

It manages item data using three parallel arrays (names, prices, and stock counts), where the same index across all three arrays refers to the same grocery item. The program provides a menu-driven interface that allows the user to view the current inventory and restock existing items.

  • Method Details

    • printInventory

      public static void printInventory(String[] names, double[] prices, int[] stocks)
      Prints the current inventory to the console.

      Iterates through the parallel arrays and prints only the slots that are not empty (i.e., where the name at that index is not null).

      Parameters:
      names - array of item names
      prices - array of item prices, parallel to names
      stocks - array of item stock counts, parallel to names

    • restockItem

      public static void restockItem(String[] names, int[] stocks, String target, int amount)
      Adds a positive quantity to an existing item's stock. Prints a message if the item is missing or the amount is invalid.
      Parameters:
      names - array of item names
      stocks - array of stock quantities
      target - name of the item to restock
      amount - positive quantity to add

    • addItem

      private static void addItem(String[] names, double[] prices, int[] stocks, String name, double price, int stock)
      Adds a new item to the first available (null) slot in the arrays. This is a small helper used by the menu so the demo data can grow; it is not one of the three required methods but supports Task 3's menu-driven interaction.
      Parameters:
      names - array of item names
      prices - array of item prices, parallel to names
      stocks - array of item stock counts, parallel to names
      name - name of the new item
      price - price of the new item
      stock - initial stock of the new item

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)
      Program entry point. Sets up the parallel arrays, seeds a few sample items, and runs a menu-driven loop allowing the user to view the inventory, restock an item, add a new item, or exit the program.
      Parameters:
      args - command-line arguments (not used)
